rationale: This is clearly authored editorial work whose structure, data graphics, annotations and responsive transformations arise directly from the report’s argument. It is strong enough for a professional studio to claim, although the extremely sparse wide layouts, occasional desktop crowding around compact tables, and repetitive chapter pacing keep it below benchmark-class.

criterionScores.note: The visual thesis is coherent: a sober research document in which measures occupy the reading column and qualifications, controls and apparatus inhabit the margin. Restrained ink, paper, rules and rust-red notation sustain that idea across every route.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: At wide widths the thesis sometimes becomes excessive vacancy rather than productive margin, and the repeated two-column chapter construction is less expressive than the strongest editorial systems.

criterionScores.note: The architecture and components are inseparable from this report: coverage matrices, reported-versus-underlying plots, catchment sparklines, explicit limitations, stable findings, citations and simulated-data warnings all embody the research method.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The underlying editorial shell could still support another evidence-led investigative report, even though its present components could not be transferred wholesale to an unrelated business.
positiveEvidence: The central interactive grid exposes coverage, reported spills and simulated discharges for each catchment-month.
Every finding is paired with what it does not support and the figure on which it rests.
Catchment profiles explicitly compare the published measurement with the simulated underlying rate.

criterionScores.note: The report is intelligently divided into report, findings, catchments, method and data. The home page states the argument and previews the evidence; dedicated routes then separate citation-ready conclusions, local records, controls and raw rows without obscuring their relationships.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The data route still presents an exceptionally long filtered record set, and the catchment index could make the relationship between overview, ranking and individual profiles more immediately navigable.
positiveEvidence: The home page progresses from premise to monitoring evidence, correlation, inversion and report contents.
Findings are stable, numbered and cross-referenced to their supporting figures.
Method, limitations, reusable data and individual catchment interpretation each have an appropriate dedicated location.

criterionScores.note: Every route establishes a decisive first read, then clearly separates argument, evidence, qualification and provenance. Headlines dominate without swallowing the page, while labels and rules make the apparatus legible.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Several wide screenshots leave the primary material quite small within a huge canvas, weakening attention, and some dense desktop table annotations compete or overlap near the top rows.

criterionScores.note: The serif display and reading face, condensed metadata, tabular figures, captions and marginal labels form a disciplined multi-level system. Type is compositional material, particularly in the home-page argument and numbered findings.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The smallest annotations become very slight at wide and desktop sizes, and a few compact table headings and notes are crowded enough to compromise the otherwise excellent typographic control.

criterionScores.note: The home page alternates argument, graphic evidence, interpretation and quieter connective sections effectively. Mobile pacing is particularly good, with endnotes and apparatus arriving after the material they qualify.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Interior pages rely repeatedly on the same reading-column-plus-margin section construction, while wide layouts create prolonged empty fields that sometimes feel under-composed rather than restful.

criterionScores.note: The chosen material is exactly right for the subject: a coverage matrix, correlation plot, paired time series, ranking sparklines and explicit data tables. These graphics do not decorate the report; they make its central distinction between observation and underlying events visible.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The desktop and wide catchment overview compresses its table and sparklines into a relatively small area, with summary annotations visibly crowding the header region.
positiveEvidence: The coverage grid makes missing observation itself the dominant visual material.
The scatterplot overlays reported and underlying rates on the same axes so the control can be inspected.
Catchment time-series charts directly show the gap between simulated discharges and what working monitors would report.

criterionScores.note: Captured states show purposeful hover, focus and reduced-motion handling: grid cells update a shared readout, keyboard focus reproduces hover information, navigation distinguishes current and hovered states, rows respond, filters announce counts and a skip link appears on first Tab.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The evidence covers a thoughtful but fairly narrow interaction vocabulary; it does not demonstrate broader behaviours such as filtering transitions, chart exploration, download feedback or error and loading states.

criterionScores.note: Mobile is demonstrably redesigned rather than merely stacked. The sixty-month matrix becomes five comparable annual columns, the seven-column catchment table becomes legible records with full-width sparklines, and desktop margins fold into properly measured endnotes.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The data route remains an extremely long sequence of individual records on phone, and the persistent five-link navigation is already close to its practical width limit.
positiveEvidence: The coverage graphic changes aggregation on phone to preserve comparison rather than shrinking or horizontally scrolling.
Catchment rows become purpose-built mobile records while retaining every important measure and sparkline.
Marginal qualifications move beneath their associated reading content instead of collapsing into narrow side columns.

criterionScores.note: The restrained investigative-report language feels credible for a small independent data unit addressing reporters, regulators and river communities. Its visible methodology, qualifications, citations and simulation warnings communicate seriousness without borrowing institutional gloss.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The identity is more recognisably that of a rigorous independent report than uniquely Stell; the organisation itself has limited visual character beyond the publication system.
positiveEvidence: The apparatus is always visible rather than hidden behind polished conclusions.
Rust-red emphasis behaves like editorial correction and annotation rather than marketing decoration.
Funding, reuse and prototype disclosures remain prominent across routes and widths.

criterionScores.note: For a report rather than a conventional product, the proposition is immediate, navigation is plain, trust material is conspicuous and the persistent Download & cite action gives readers an obvious next step.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The screenshots do not show the download interaction or its available formats, and some visitors may need a shorter explicit summary of what they should do differently after accepting the finding.

criterionScores.note: The work almost entirely avoids generic generated-site motifs. Its severity, custom data representations, marginal apparatus, stable citation system and refusal to turn evidence into cards all trace back to the report’s actual intellectual problem.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: A few broad editorial conventions—large serif headlines, abundant cream space and thin rules—are fashionable enough that the surface language alone is not wholly unprecedented.
positiveEvidence: There are no generic feature-card grids, gradient slogans, fake testimonials, logo walls, glowing decoration or closing CTA slab.
Whitespace is tied to the document’s margin-and-apparatus concept rather than a luxury-product pose.
The custom figures, limitations and record transformations are specific to the monitoring argument.

criterionScores.note: The signature experience is the watchfulness grid: missing observation becomes the report’s visual field, and selecting a cell reveals both what would have been published and what the simulation says occurred. That interaction turns the report’s thesis into something directly inspectable.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Beyond the grid and paired measurement graphics, the wider site uses a deliberately restrained editorial language that is less instantly unmistakable than the very strongest singular digital publications.
positiveEvidence: The grid’s darkness represents estate coverage rather than pollution, reversing the reader’s expected visual interpretation.
Pointer, keyboard and reduced-motion states all preserve the same evidentiary readout.
The mobile annual aggregation protects the comparison instead of preserving desktop geometry.

signatureMoment: The interactive watchfulness grid, where each catchment-month reveals monitor coverage beside the spills that would be published and the discharges the simulation says occurred, then deliberately becomes an annual comparison matrix on mobile.

comparisons.note: The candidate has a clear measure-and-margin thesis, but the reference sustains a broader and more expressive editorial language across dense material.

The candidate’s typography is highly considered, while the reference more fully resolves dense annotation, multiple hierarchy levels and long-form rhythm without the candidate’s occasional tiny or crowded desktop text.
The reference demonstrates more varied tension and release across a long document; the candidate repeats its split-column scaffold and sometimes lets wide-screen whitespace become inert.
Both turn substantial evidence into a navigable argument. The candidate’s separation of findings, catchments, method and raw data is especially disciplined.
The candidate shows genuine mobile redesign through changed aggregation, record-based tables and folded margins, meeting the reference at the level of responsive decision-making visible here.
The candidate’s keyboard, hover and reduced-motion details are excellent, but the visible table-header crowding and under-scaled wide compositions leave more unresolved edges.
The watchfulness grid is memorable and germane, but the reference’s entire reading rhythm is described as a signature experience rather than relying chiefly on one outstanding evidentiary device.
The candidate’s architecture, figures and qualifications are deeply generated by the monitoring problem and would be inappropriate for an unrelated sector.

benchmarkGapDetail: Nowhere near benchmark class. The reference is stronger on most dimensions and by a wide margin.

evidenceCeiling.detail: Evidence covers all 7 route(s) of this artifact at 4 viewport(s). Nothing is unphotographed, so evidence caps the claim at 10.
